claims.claim: Domain-separated HMAC binds synthetic issuer token and local commit receipt to canonical action and identifiers.
claims.falsifier: Change an action field or token body without a valid MAC and observe an accepted new effect.

claims.claim: Single shared SQLite file gives idempotent one-effect behavior for one exact signed intent under tested local concurrency.
claims.falsifier: Under tested conditions produce two effect rows or two COMMITTED responses for the same effect and grant.

claims.claim: Simulated post-commit response loss can be reconciled using a local authenticated receipt without a second commit.
claims.falsifier: Lose a response then observe missing local receipt or duplicate effect after identical replay.

claims.claim: Constructed ledger modifications and historical prefix rewrites are detected when an independently held anchor is supplied.
claims.falsifier: Tamper with ledger or rewrite its prefix while preserving presented anchor and still pass local integrity checks.

claims.claim: A false trusted source record may still produce a cryptographically valid local commitment receipt.
claims.falsifier: Under same authored false-truth scenario the commit is refused based on a source independent from the trusted status record.

claims.claim: Real Lycheetah Framework integration and remote provider commit correctness are unverified.
claims.falsifier: Execute import-based contract suite against pinned Framework checkout and conduct a real external provider integration test with independent observations.

claims.claim: The experiment is superior to a conventional conditional transaction and authorization baseline.
claims.falsifier: Independent matched evaluation may show no difference, or worse results, relative to conventional implementation.
